ok.label: Read-only (recommended)
ok.summary: Invoices, payments, refunds and payouts, payment requests, and a wallet check that recognises which wallet each store pays into. On BTCPay Server 2.4 and later it also reads each store's on-chain wallet history. The key cannot change your store.
manual_steps: Sign in to BTCPay Server with the account that owns the store.
Open Account → Manage Account → API Keys and choose Generate Key.
Label the key 'Kassiber' and enable only: View your stores (btcpay.store.canviewstoresettings), View wallets (btcpay.store.canviewwallet).
Leave the permission on all stores so one key serves every store, then generate the key.
Copy the key into Kassiber. BTCPay shows it again on the API Keys page if you need it later.
